svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: ehr-rwe-eln: one OMOP database, six modules, all on one machine
svg.desc: Synthea patients and Athena vocabularies become an OMOP CDM v5.4 database in Postgres. Data quality checks, target trial emulation, synthetic data releases, and a synthetic genotype study read it; the ELN bridge writes lab results into it with Claude. A FastAPI app serves the results on 127.0.0.1.
svg.text: Dashed boxes are outside the machine. Open the SVG on its own and hover a box for what it does and why.

g.title: docker compose up -d starts the database, the app, and the privacy monitor. No cloud account; the only outside service is the Anthropic API, on your own key. There is no sign-in, which is why nothing listens beyond this machine.
The dashboards: data quality, target trials, ELN extraction, and synthetic releases.

a.title: One container serves the API under /api and the frontend at /. The frontend is a Next.js static export, so no Node server runs. Routes for data quality, trials, ELN, synthetic data, and the agent at POST /api/agent.
One database, ehr_rwe_eln, with 23,421 people. Schemas: cdm, dq, tte, eln, synth. Tests use ehr_rwe_eln_test. Data lives in the ehr-rwe-eln-db volume.
Every build and analysis step is a script run with uv run python scripts/<name>.py. Each writes to ehr_rwe_eln.
Hail pins pandas below 3, PySpark 3.5, and Java 11, so it gets its own 2.4 GB image, built only by docker compose run --rm --build hail. No ports; it reads and writes data/genomics.

Reruns the privacy attacks on every release when a source table or the synth code has changed since the last check, and skips otherwise. Each run is a row in synth.monitor_run; the last one shows on /synth/. Set MONITOR_INTERVAL_HOURS in .env.

g.title: The cohort pipeline builds the OMOP tables every other module reads. The ELN bridge writes lab results back into them.

a.title: Open-source synthetic patient generator. Seed and reference date are fixed, so the same arguments give the same people: 23,421 by default.
SNOMED, LOINC, RxNorm, CVX, and ICD10CM, plus Gender, Race, and Ethnicity. Downloaded under their own licenses and never committed.
Free-text lab notebook entries on 200 hypertension subjects, generated with the extraction each should produce. Default, hard, and adversarial entries (prompt injections included).
The only outside service. Extraction runs through the Message Batches API at half price. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY lives only in .env.
Synthea CSV to OMOP CDM v5.4, checked against OHDSI ETL-Synthea with every difference explained. Condition and drug eras, keys and indices, then cohorts built from YAML definitions.
Claude extracts samples and results into a Pydantic model, validated before anything is stored. Scored for precision and recall against the known answers.
The one database every module shares: person, visits, conditions, drugs, measurements, eras, cohorts, and the ELN's specimen and measurement rows.
The same samples and results as FHIR R4 resources, in data/eln/fhir_bundle.json, for systems that speak FHIR rather than OMOP.
Every check in OHDSI DataQualityDashboard v2.9.0, grouped by the Kahn framework (conformance, completeness, plausibility), scored, and matched against DQD itself.
Eligibility, strategies, time zero, and outcomes in YAML. Propensity score weights, weighted Kaplan-Meier risks, Cox hazard ratios, bootstrap intervals, and negative control outcomes.
Differentially private Bayesian network and DP-SGD autoencoder releases, an independent-columns baseline, and a 30% holdout to judge them against.

5,000 adults on three simulated chromosomes, with an odds ratio of 1.4 planted on hypertension. A GWAS is checked against the planted effect. A clinical panel puts real ClinVar variants at their GRCh38 positions in the same people.

Classifies the panel's variants with each gene's ClinGen expert panel thresholds, from gnomAD v4 frequencies and Ensembl VEP consequences, and scores the rules against ClinVar expert panels. Results in the curation schema.
Each run's checks, thresholds, and pass rates, shown at /dq/.
Attrition, balance, estimates, and negative controls for each protocol, shown at /tte/.
Each release with its provenance, fidelity, utility, trial parity, and privacy risk reports, plus a data card per release. Shown at /synth/.
Laid out as dbGaP distributes a study. The registry linking study codes to persons is written apart, to data/registry/.
Reruns the GWAS in Hail and compares score statistics variant by variant with the Python GWAS.

g.title: What runs before code reaches main.

a.title: Lint, format, YAML, large-file, and private-key checks before a commit lands.
main is protected: every change arrives as a pull request, up to date with main, with lint-test passing, and is squash-merged.
uv sync --locked, ruff, and pytest against the same pgvector image as Compose.
Fast tests on small planted data, each in a rolled-back transaction in its own test database. Nothing leaves the machine.
Golden cases for the agent and ELN extraction against Claude. Slow and billed, so never in CI.
